title: Aux Control — Let the whole room vote on the music
excerpt: Everyone queues a song, the room votes, the winner plays next — for parties, bars, and wedding DJs. No app or account needed to join.
content_html:
Start a new session or join one already in progress

or

Aux Control is a social music experiment for the aux cord: everyone queues up a track, the group votes, and the winner plays next. Works for house parties, bars, and wedding DJs fielding song requests — best with 5 or more people. Guests never need an account — Apple Music is how the host plays full tracks, hands-free.

Aux Control 是针对辅助线的社交音乐实验：每个人排队播放一首曲目，小组投票，然后获胜者播放。 适用于家庭聚会、酒吧和婚礼 DJ 处理歌曲请求 - 最好适合 5 人或更多人。 客人永远不需要帐户 - Apple Music 是主持人免提播放完整曲目的方式。
